name: 17529 · Gordonville, PA
findings: ZIP 17529 (Gordonville) has 9 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (67%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 17529 (Gordonville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 17529 (Gordonville) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.
